verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Mailchimp Transactional's webhooks, which emit per-message hard-bounce, soft-bounce, spam (complaint) and reject events, plus a rejection allowlist/denylist API. These give raw per-send bounce and complaint signals, but only via webhook integration, and the Marketing campaign reports evidenced cover just opens and clicks. missing for 10: bounce/complaint reporting in marketer-facing campaign reports, blocklist monitoring, deliverability-degradation alerts, actionable remediation guidance, independent corroboration.
